players.bio: Aaron James Ramsey (born 21 January 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Burnley. A product of the Aston Villa Academy, he has represented England at youth level up to under-20 level.
Andréas William Edwin Hountondji (born 11 July 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Burnley. Born in France, he plays for the Benin national team.

Anel Ahmedhodžić (pronounced [ǎnel ǎxmedxodʒitɕ]; born 26 March 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Burnley. Born in Sweden, he played for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team. Ahmedhodžić started his professional career at Nottingham Forest, before joining Malmö FF in 2019, who loaned him to Hobro IK later that year and to Bordeaux in 2022.

Armando Broja is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Burnley. Club career Chelsea On 26 February 2020, Broja signed his first professional contract with Premier League side Chelsea after agreeing to a two-year deal.

Ashley Luke Barnes is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Burnley. Barnes previously played for Paulton Rovers, Plymouth Argyle, Oxford United, Salisbury City, Eastbourne Borough, Torquay United, Brighton & Hove Albion and Norwich City.
Bashir Humphreys (born 15 March 2003) is an English footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Burnley.

Benjamin Paul Amos (born 10 April 1990) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Burnley. He was capped by England up to under-21 level. Amos was released from the Academy at Crewe Alexandra as a midfielder at the age of ten. He converted to playing in goal and earned a place at the Academy at Manchester United a year later.

Christopher Martin Casper (born 28 April 1975) is an English football manager and former player who is the academy manager at EFL Championship side Burnley. As a player he was a defender who played in the Premier League for Manchester United and in the Football League for AFC Bournemouth, Swindon Town and Reading. An injury forced him to retire from playing in 2000 at the age of 24.
Connor Richard John Roberts (born 23 September 1995) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Burnley, and the Wales national team.

Dastan Talgatuly Satpayev (Kazakh: Дастан Талғатұлы Сатпаев; born 12 August 2008) is a Kazakh professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Burnley, on loan from Premier League club Chelsea, and the Kazakhstan national team.

Fabio Celestini (born 31 October 1975) is a Swiss football manager and former player who is the head coach of EFL Championship club Burnley. A defensive midfielder, he started and finished his 15-year professional career with Lausanne, and also played for ten years in France and Spain, representing four clubs. He appeared with the Swiss national team at Euro 2004.
Grégoire Coudert (born 3 April 1999) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Burnley.

Hannibal Mejbri (Arabic: حَنِّبَعْل المجبري; born 21 January 2003), also known mononymously as Hannibal, is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Burnley. Born in France, he plays for the Tunisia national team. Mejbri joined the Manchester United youth system in 2019 from Monaco. He had previously spent time at the Clairefontaine academy.

Hjalmar Ekdal (Swedish: [ˈjǎlmar ˈêːkdɑːl]; born 21 October 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Burnley and the Sweden national team. He is the younger brother of former footballer Albin Ekdal.

Igor Julio dos Santos de Paulo (born 7 February 1998), known as Igor Julio or simply Igor, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for EFL Championship club Burnley.

Jacob Bruun Larsen (born 19 September 1998) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a left winger or attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Burnley and the Denmark national team. Bruun Larsen represented Denmark at UEFA Euro 2024. He also competed at the 2016 Summer Olympics.

Jamie Richard Vardy (né Gill; born 11 January 1987) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Burnley. After being released by Sheffield Wednesday at age 16, Vardy began his senior career with Stocksbridge Park Steels.
Jaydon Amauri Banel (born 19 October 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship for EFL Championship club Burnley.
Joshua Jon Cullen (born 7 April 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Burnley and the Republic of Ireland national team.
Joshua Ishaele Jacob-Heron Laurent (born 6 May 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship clubt Burnley.

Kyle Andrew Walker (born 28 May 1990) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Burnley and the England national team. Known for his exceptional speed, he is regarded as one of the best right-backs of his generation.
Largie Ramazani (born 27 February 2001) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a left midfielder for EFL Championship club Burnley on loan from Premier League club Leeds United.
Louis Jordan Beyer (born 19 May 2000) is a German professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Burnley. He has represented Germany at U16 through U21 youth levels.
Lucas Pires Silva (born 24 March 2001) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Burnley.

Marcus Edwards (born 3 December 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger or attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Burnley. Born in England, he plays for the Cyprus national team. Edwards began his senior career at Tottenham Hotspur, where he made one substitute appearance in the EFL Cup.
Max Lewis Rowe Alleyne (born 21 July 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Burnley, on loan from Premier League club Manchester City.
Max Oliver Weiß (born 15 June 2004) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Burnley.
Michael Oluwadurotimi Obafemi (born 6 July 2000) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Burnley. He is a Republic of Ireland international.

Michael James Jackson (born 4 December 1973) is an English football manager and former professional footballer. He is currently assistant head coach for EFL Championship club Burnley. As a player, Jackson was a defender who played in the Football League for Crewe Alexandra, Bury, Preston North End, Tranmere Rovers, Blackpool and Shrewsbury Town.

Mike Trésor Ndayishimiye (born 28 May 1999), commonly known as Mike Tresor, is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or left winger for EFL Championship club Burnley, and the Belgium national team.

Shurandy Ruggerio Sambo (born 19 August 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a right back for EFL Championship club Burnley. Born in the Netherlands, he represents the Curaçao national team.

Ugo David Raghouber (French pronunciation: [yɡo ʁaɡubɛʁ] u-go ra-goo-BAIR; born 13 July 2003) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Burnley.
Youl Mawéné (born 16 July 1979) is a French football coach and former professional player who is the strength and conditioning coach at Burnley.
Mohamed Zeki Amdouni (born 4 December 2000) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for EFL Championship club Burnley and the Switzerland national team.
